name: QR Code Presentment Mode 1 Code
definition: Identifies the mode used to present a QR Code for a transaction.

CPMD.name: Consumer Presented
CPMD.definition: The consumer presented a QR Code at the point of service for the transaction.

OTHN.name: Other National
OTHN.definition: Other nationally defined method for QR Code presentment for the transaction.

OTHP.name: Other Private
OTHP.definition: Other QR Code presentment mode defined by bilateral agreement.

MPMD.name: Merchant Presented
MPMD.definition: The acceptor presented a QR Code to the consumer for the transaction.
